description: This file provides utility functions for cache management, including cache creation with expiration, pruning, and file stat snapshotting.

methods.name: resolveCacheTtlMs
methods.description: Resolves cache TTL in milliseconds from environment value or default.

methods.name: isCacheEnabled
methods.description: Determines if cache is enabled based on TTL.

methods.name: createExpiringMapCache
methods.description: Creates a cache with expiration and pruning capabilities.

methods.name: getFileStatSnapshot
methods.description: Returns file's modification time and size as a snapshot.
